tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia unveiled an OOI CPO prototype, reported by DigiTimes, designed for post-2028 artificial intelligence needs.
Anthropic delayed its Mythos artificial intelligence release over safety concerns, reported by TechGig, losing competitive lead.
Reported by BNN Bloomberg: OpenAI resumed frontier artificial intelligence training after a security overhaul and disclosed a flaw in widely used software.
Moonshot artificial intelligence's Kimi K3.1 Pro scores 65.7 percent on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and 92.7 percent on BenchCAD, reported by Crowdfund Insider, challenging US frontier models on coding, agents and finance.
Traders are letting xAI's Grok Bot run unsupervised, reported by Startup Fortune, and it already lost money.
Free every hour.
